Subject: Redwood Inference - Procurement & billing requirements (follow-up from call)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call this morning — quick recap and a few questions from our procurement/billing side so we can get internal approvals started.

Recap:
- We like Redwood's runtime and your pricing profile looks reasonable for our pilot.
- We'll start with 3 reserved seats + usage for the PoC.

Procurement / Billing questions:
1) Does Redwood accept Purchase Orders? If so, what are your standard payment terms (Net 30/45/60)?
2) Do you require a signed MSA before onboarding? We usually route PO + MSA to Finance.
3) Invoice formatting: we need invoice to include our VAT/Tax ID, full billing address, and a customer PO number field.
4) Do you support consolidated monthly invoices (single invoice for multiple seats/projects)?
5) Marketplace options: would prefer to buy via AWS Marketplace if possible — are you listed there and can you provide the procurement path?

Can you send a sample invoice and the MSA (or indicate the DocuSign link) so I can share with our Finance team? Also include who on your side will be our billing contact.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Procurement Lead
Acme Health
alice.chen@acmehealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - Procurement & billing requirements (follow-up from call)

Hi Alice — great talking with you earlier. Quick recap + what we can provide next.

Thanks for the clear list — answers below and next steps.

Answers:
- Purchase Orders: yes, we accept POs. Standard public terms are Net 30, but we can discuss Net 45 if required for enterprise setups.
- MSA: we do request a signed MSA for Dedicated/reserved capacity. I attached our standard MSA and a sample invoice for format reference.
- Invoice fields: we can include VAT/Tax ID, full billing address, customer PO number, and a line-item breakdown by seat + usage.
- Consolidated invoicing: we support consolidated monthly invoicing for a single billing account.
- Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace. For AWS procurement we can either invoice directly or route through the Marketplace (Marketplace invoicing may incur different terms).

Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Sample.pdf, Master_Services_Agreement.pdf

Next steps:
1) I'll assign Neha (cc'd) to be your billing ops contact — she'll confirm the invoice template and VAT handling.
2) If you're proceeding via PO, please send the PO PDF and your billing address + VAT number.
3) If you'd like marketplace procurement, reply and we'll share the AWS Marketplace listing and guidance for procurement.

Rishi (cc) will be your AE for contractual/pricing questions; he'll follow up on commercial terms and any purchase order routing items.

If you can send your procurement form back (or confirm whether PO + signed MSA is your preferred flow), we can loop in legal and billing to get this started.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Alice — thanks for the details and the procurement form. Confirming the plan below so we have a single source of truth: 

Confirmed:
- Payment method: Purchase Order (PO) — Net 30 accepted.
- Invoice format: we will include Acme Health's VAT/Tax ID (ACME-VAT-987654), the parent billing address you provided, and a dedicated Customer PO field.
